description: Change your profile and settings. Only the fields you pass change. For your picture use UpdateAvatar.

avatar_shape.description: Your default mark, hidden while a custom picture is installed.

drafting_disabled.description: Pass false to turn draft cards back on when the user asks. You can't turn them off; tell the user to click "Disable drafts for this Bot" on a draft card. Owner only.

hidden_from_sidebar.description: Hides your sidebar row; you stay reachable through Cmd-K and Hidden chats.

name.description: Your name, the chat title the user sees.

notify_on_updates.description: The "Notify me about this assistant" toggle.

title.description: Short role label beside your name ("Designer"); "" clears it.
